effective.basis: TCG release of Champion Pack: Game One (CP01-EN014)

changes.historical_text: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, destroy all monsters with an ATK equal to 1400 or less that are Normal Summoned or Special Summoned.
changes.modern_text: Destroy all monsters with an ATK of 1400 or less that are Normal Summoned or Special Summoned.
changes.summary: Wording modernisation only: CP01-EN014 drops the 'As long as this card remains face-up on the field' preamble and the 'an ATK equal to' phrasing. The mandatory destruction of every Normal or Special Summoned monster with 1400 or less ATK is unchanged.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the added 'This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect' clause (BP01-EN129, Battle Pack: Epic Dawn)

changes.historical_text: Destroy all monsters with an ATK of 1400 or less that are Normal Summoned or Special Summoned.
changes.modern_text: When a monster(s) with 1400 or less ATK is Normal Summoned or Special Summoned: Destroy those monsters with 1400 or less ATK. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.
changes.summary: Functional erratum: BP01 added 'This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect', which the modern script enforces with the extra clause 'not eg:IsContains(e:GetHandler())' in the condition of its mandatory summon trigger. Under the era text the trigger also fires when King Tiger Wanghu itself is part of the summoned group, so a simultaneous Special Summon of Wanghu together with monsters of 1400 or less ATK destroys those monsters; the modern card does not activate at all in that case. Everything else is identical in both scripts: a mandatory (TRIGGER_F) field trigger on EVENT_SUMMON_SUCCESS and EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS, filtering face-up monsters with 1400 or less ATK, suppressed while Wanghu is battle-destroyed.

review.notes: Chain starts at lineage v1 (DB2-EN207, 2005-07-27), the version the GOAT entry's text matches exactly. The earlier v0 (PGD-004, 2003-07-18) -> v1 transition dropped the '(excluding Flip Summon)' parenthetical; that is a clarification removal rather than a behaviour change (neither script hooks a Flip Summon event - only EVENT_SUMMON_SUCCESS and EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS), and it predates the baseline, so it is recorded here rather than in changes. Trailing lineage v4 (OP24-EN004, 2024-02-14) rewords to 'If a monster(s) ... is Normal or Special Summoned while you control this card'; the pinned cdb text is still v3, so v4 is not recorded. Upstream annotation on the GOAT script: 'Triggers on its own summon'.
